arxiv-1809-05455.title: Experimental few-copy multi-particle entanglement detection
arxiv-1809-05455.creator: Valeria Saggio 1∗, Aleksandra Dimić 2, Chiara Greganti 1, Lee A. Rozema 1, Philip Walther 1, Borivoje Dakić 1,3
arxiv-1809-05455.description: Abstract Quantum technologies lead to a variety of applications that outperform their classical counterparts. In order to build a quantum device it must be verified that it operates below some error threshold. Recently, because of technological developments which allow for the experimental realization of quantum states with increasing complexity, these tasks must be applied to large multi-qubit states.

arxiv-2105-07127.title: Software-Hardware Co-Optimization for Computational Chemistry on Superconducting Quantum Processors
arxiv-2105-07127.creator: Gushu Li, Yunong Shi, Ali Javadi-Abhari
arxiv-2105-07127.description: Abstract Computational chemistry is the leading application to demonstrate the advantage of quantum computing in the near term. However, large-scale simulation of chemical systems on quantum computers is currently hindered due to a mismatch between the computational resource needs of the program and those available in today’s technology.

arxiv-2201-07858.title: Decoupling the Depth and Scope of Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2201-07858.creator: Hanqing Zeng, Muhan Zhang, Yinglong Xia, Ajitesh Srivastava, Andrey Malevich, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna, Long Jin, Ren Chen
arxiv-2201-07858.description: Abstract State-of-the-art Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have limited scalability with respect to the graph and model sizes. On large graphs, increasing the model depth often means exponential expansion of the scope ( i.e. , receptive field). Beyond just a few layers, two fundamental challenges emerge: 1. degraded expressivity due to oversmoothing, and 2. expensive computation due to neighborhood explosion.

arxiv-2206-06667.title: Improved White Dwarves Constraints on Inelastic Dark Matter and Left–Right Symmetric Models
arxiv-2206-06667.creator: Liliana Velasco-Sevilla
arxiv-2206-06667.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Liliana Velasco-Sevilla. Weakly Interacting Massive Particles (WIMPs) can be captured in compact stars such as white dwarves (WDs) if they are in a Dark Matter (DM)–rich environment, leading to an increase in the star luminosity through their annihilation process. N–body simulations suggest that the core of the Messier 4 globular cluster (where plenty of WDs are observed) is rich of Dark Matter.

arxiv-2301-00753.title: Polynomial representation of additive cyclic codes and new quantum codes
arxiv-2301-00753.creator: Reza Dastbasteh and Khalil Shivji
arxiv-2301-00753.description: Abstract . We give a polynomial representation for additive cyclic codes over 𝔽 p 2 \mathbb{F}_{p^{2}} . This representation will be applied to uniquely present each additive cyclic code by at most two generator polynomials. We determine the generator polynomials of all different additive cyclic codes.

arxiv-2301-05835.title: A Novel Multi-Layer Framework for BVLoS Drone Operation: A Preliminary Study
arxiv-2301-05835.creator: Francesco Betti Sorbelli, Punyasha Chatterjee, Federico Corò, Lorenzo Palazzetti, Cristina M. Pinotti

However, most drone operations are currently limited to within Visual Line of Sight (VLoS) due to safety concerns.

arxiv-2305-10143.title: An Empirical Study on the Language Modal in Visual Question Answering
arxiv-2305-10143.creator: Daowan Peng, Wei Wei, Xian-Ling Mao, Yuanyuan Fu, Dangyang Chen
arxiv-2305-10143.description: Abstract Generalization beyond in-domain experience to out-of-distribution data is of paramount significance in the AI domain. Of late, state-of-the-art Visual Question Answering (VQA) models have shown impressive performance on in-domain data, partially due to the language priors bias which, however, hinders the generalization ability in practice.

arxiv-2406-01787.title: Bosonization of 2+1 dimensional fermions on the surface of topological insulators
arxiv-2406-01787.creator: Andrea Cappelli, Lorenzo Maffi, Riccardo Villa
arxiv-2406-01787.description: Abstract Three-dimensional topological insulators can be described by an effective field theory involving two ‘hydrodynamic’ Abelian gauge fields. The action contains a bulk topological BF term and a surface term, called loop model. This describes the massless 2+1 dimensional excitations and provides them with a semiclassical, yet non-trivial conformal invariant dynamics.

arxiv-2407-07700.title: Split Conformal Prediction under Data Contamination
arxiv-2407-07700.creator: Jase Clarkson, Wenkai Xu, Mihai Cucuringu, Yvik Swan, Gesine Reinert
arxiv-2407-07700.description: Abstract Conformal prediction is a nonparametric technique for constructing prediction intervals or sets from arbitrary predictive models. It is popular because it comes with theoretical guarantees on the marginal coverage of the prediction sets when the data are exchangeable, and the split conformal prediction variant has low computational cost compared to model training.

arxiv-2411-13807.title: MagicDrive-V2 : High-Resolution Long Video Generation for Autonomous Driving with Adaptive Control
arxiv-2411-13807.creator: Ruiyuan Gao, Kai Chen, Bo Xiao, Lanqing Hong, Zhenguo Li, Qiang Xu
arxiv-2411-13807.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of diffusion models has greatly improved video synthesis, especially in controllable video generation, which is vital for applications like autonomous driving. Although DiT with 3D VAE has become a standard framework for video generation, it introduces challenges in controllable driving video generation, especially for frame-wise geometric control, rendering existing methods ineffective.

arxiv-2501-19124.title: Optimal constrained control for generally damped Brownian heat engines
arxiv-2501-19124.creator: Monojit Chatterjee, Viktor Holubec, Rahul Marathe
arxiv-2501-19124.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Monojit Chatterjee, Viktor Holubec, Rahul Marathe. Optimization of cyclic stochastic heat engines, a topic spanning decades of research, commonly assumes fixed control or response parameters at discrete points in the cycle—a limitation that often leads to experimentally impractical protocols. We overcome this with a general algorithm, adapted from optimal control theory, that optimizes full-cycle dynamics under realistic constraints, such as stiffness and temperature bounds, across diverse systems.

pmc-13534626.title: 沙参麦冬汤通过抑制cGAS-STING-NF-κB介导的炎性衰老改善老年COPD小鼠肺功能
pmc-13534626.creator: Xiangnan Kuang, Xingran Liu, Xinyao Zhao, Xuexiao Chen, Shiqiao Liu
pmc-13534626.description: 目的观察沙参麦冬汤对慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）模型小鼠炎性衰老的影响，明确其是否通过调控环鸟苷酸-腺苷酸合成酶（cGAS）-干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）-核因子-κB（NF-κB）通路起效。方法选用18～20月龄雌雄各半C57BL/6JNifdc小鼠，以香烟烟雾暴露联合鼻滴脂多糖构建COPD模型，随机分6组：正常组、模型组、沙参麦冬汤低/中/高剂量组（8.3、16.5、33.0 g/kg）、地塞米松组（3 mg/kg），每组8只（雌雄各4只）。造模次日起每日灌胃（正常/模型组灌羧甲基纤维素钠，0.15 mL/10 g），周期12周。检测各组小鼠肺功能〔气道阻力（Rrs）、肺弹性阻力（Ers）、0.2 s用力呼气量与用力肺活量比值（FEV0.2/FVC）、50%肺活量时的用力呼气流量（FEF50%）〕、肺组织病理（HE 染色、Masson染色）、血清炎症因子〔白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、单核细胞趋化蛋白-1（MCP-1）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）〕、氧化应激指标〔超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、丙二醛（MDA）〕，以及肺组织衰老蛋白（p16、p21）、cGAS-STING-NF-κB通路分子的mRNA与蛋白表达。结果与正常组相比，模型组小鼠肺功能受损，表现为Rrs升高，Ers、FEV0.2/FVC及FEF50%降低；肺组织出现大量炎症细胞浸润、细支气管壁增厚以及肺泡结构破坏；血清炎症因子及MDA升高、SOD降低，差异均有统计学意义（P<0.01）；肺组织衰老蛋白与cGAS-STING-NF-κB通路分子的mRNA及蛋白表达量亦升高（P<0.01）。与模型组相比，沙参麦冬汤中、高剂量组上述肺功能指标得到改善；血清炎症因子与MDA水平下降、SOD活性升高（P<0.05）；同时，肺组织衰老蛋白与通路分子的表达下调（P<0.05）。结论沙参麦冬汤可改善COPD小鼠以FEV0.2/FVC为核心的肺功能受损，其潜在机制可能为抑制cGAS-STING-NF-κB通路介导的炎性衰老。Keywords: 肺疾病，慢性阻塞性, 沙参麦冬汤, 衰老, 炎症, NF-κB 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, COPD）以持续气流受限为特征，长期暴露于刺激性颗粒引发的慢性炎症是其主要诱因[1]。作为全球第三大死因，COPD在65岁以上人群中患病率极高[2]。然而，与年龄相关的变化在加速COPD发病机制中的作用尚不清楚[3]。现有常规治疗无法有效阻止老年患者肺功能的进行性下降，且长期使用糖皮质激素不良反应较多[4]。 传统中医学将COPD归属于“肺胀”“喘证”等范畴，老年患者多属肺肾阴虚、气阴两虚证[5-6]。沙参麦冬汤源于清代吴鞠通《温病条辨》，是养阴润肺的经典方剂[7]。临床证实其可有效缓解COPD症状、延缓肺功能衰退并减少急性加重频率[8]。 炎性衰老（inflammaging）是指增龄伴随的慢性低度炎症状态，是连接衰老与多种老年疾病的关键[9-10]。研究发现，老年COPD患者外周血中白细胞介素（interleukin, IL）-6、肿瘤坏死因子-α（tumor necrosis factor-α, TNF-α）等炎症因子水平升高且伴随肺功能下降[11]。该慢性炎症可促发衰老相关分泌表型（senescence-associated secretory phenotype, SASP），形成“炎症-衰老”恶性循环[12]。近年来发现，氧化应激等损伤可导致线粒体DNA泄漏，被胞质环鸟苷酸-腺苷酸合成酶（cyclic GMP-AMP synthase, cGAS）识别并激活干扰素基因刺激因子（timulator of interferon genes, STING），进而磷酸化核因子-κB（nuclear factor kappa-B, NF-κB）以诱导促炎因子表达[13-14]。这提示cGAS-STING-NF-κB通路可能是介导炎性衰老参与老年COPD发病的重要机制。 因此，本研究以炎性衰老为切入点，探讨沙参麦冬汤通过调控cGAS-STING-NF-κB通路改善老年COPD小鼠肺功能的分子机制，为中医药防治老年COPD提供新的理论依据和实验证据。 材料与方法 实验动物 研究使用老年C57BL/6JNifdc小鼠（18～20月龄，体质量20～25 g），雌雄各半〔北京维通利华实验动物技术有限公司，许可证号SCXK（京）2021-0006〕。小鼠饲养在河北中医药大学实验动物中心，饲养条件为温度20～24 ℃，湿度40%～60%，并采用12 h光照与12 h黑暗交替的周期，提供自由饮食和饮水。饲养期间记录小鼠体质量变化，保障各组基础生理状态均衡。本实验纳入标准为：健康且适应性饲养期间体质量变化正常、无异常行为的小鼠；排除标准为：造模期间非预期死亡、状态极度萎靡无法耐受后续实验的小鼠。本实验经河北中医药大学实验动物管理和伦理委员会批准（编号DWLL202403108），实验方案已明确雌雄动物饲养、造模及检测全流程，符合动物实验性别因素控制规范。 实验药物 本研究所用沙参麦冬汤（以下简称SMD）由沙参、麦冬、玉竹、甘草、生扁豆、冬桑叶、天花粉7味中药组成，各饮片具体信息如下：沙参9 g（批号：20200915）、麦冬9 g（批号：20201022）、玉竹6 g（批号：20200817）、甘草3 g（批号：20201103）、生扁豆4.5 g（批号：20200928）、冬桑叶4.5 g（批号：20201012）、天花粉4.5 g（批号：20200830），均购自河北省中医院中药房，并经鉴定为正品，符合《中华人民共和国药典》（2020 年版）要求。水煎剂制备：将上述饮片置于砂锅中，加入8倍量蒸馏水浸泡30 min，武火煮沸后改文火保持微沸30 min，滤取药液；药渣再加6倍量蒸馏水同法煎煮20 min，合并两次煎液，经100目筛网过滤后浓缩，4 ℃冷藏备用。根据小鼠与人（70 kg）体质量的剂量换算法，确定小鼠的灌胃剂量，以临床等效剂量作为沙参麦冬汤的中剂量，低剂量和高剂量分别为等效剂量的0.5倍和2倍。最终，沙参麦冬汤低、中、高剂量组的给药量分别为8.3 g/kg、16.
